purpose: Runs an app in headless Chrome for an end-to-end proof: starts Chrome with a throwaway profile, drives the page over the DevTools Protocol, takes screenshots, collects console errors, and runs named legs that print PASS or FAIL.

host.replaces: run-8 app/scripts/e2e-fake.mjs: the Chrome launch (the port, profile and spawn) and the cleanup; apps/pictures-example/scripts/browser-proof.mjs: the same
the Cdp class copied into e2e-fake.mjs and pictures-example browser-proof.mjs
run-8 app/scripts/e2e-fake.mjs: leg(), shot(), the results list and the exit code

library.title: Browser proof (headless Chrome end-to-end harness)
library.note: Node test helper, no packages, no React: startBrowser launches headless Chrome with a throwaway profile in a folder you name and gives a page (goto, eval, waitFor, screenshot, consoleErrors, key, setViewport); runLegs runs named legs, prints PASS or FAIL for each, fails a leg that logged a page error, and exits non-zero on any FAIL. Chrome and its helpers are stopped and the profile removed, even on failure. Also found as: browser test; end-to-end test; headless Chrome; e2e harness; take screenshots in a test.
